name: fia
description: Skills for operating the Factory on a project it is installed on: file issues the Factory can plan from (fia-todo) and run issues through the Factory to merge, each in its own agent and several at once with parallel:<n>, validating kind:check follow-ups on the host (fia-conductor), and work a GitHub Project's Ready column through both, filing what each run teaches (fia-consumer). GitHub and GitLab.
